WITH channel_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.orderbase,
    AVG(f.feerate) as channel_avg
  FROM orders o 
  JOIN fees f ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink 
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL 
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(feerate) as overall_avg 
  FROM fees 
  WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL
),
above_avg_channels AS (
  SELECT cs.channel_avg, oa.overall_avg
  FROM channel_stats cs, overall_avg oa
  WHERE cs.channel_avg > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(channel_avg) as mean_above_avg_rate,
  AVG(channel_avg - overall_avg) as avg_distance_above_average
FROM above_avg_channels
